description.fun: Machop's muscles never tire or cramp, and it can lift many times its own weight, enough to hurl 100 adults. It spends its days training in every kind of martial art, using boulders and even Graveler as barbells, and the more its muscles grow, the harder it trains. Once it feels ready, it goes looking for a Makuhita to fight.
description.guide: A small, grey, humanoid Fighting Pokémon whose muscles never tire. It trains constantly in martial arts and can lift many times its own weight. It evolves into Machoke and then Machamp.
description.tagline: A pint-sized bodybuilder that bench-presses Graveler

description.fun: Machoke can lift heavy objects with one finger and has muscles as hard as steel, yet it's modest and often helps people with heavy manual labour. The championship-style belt it wears keeps its power in check; it only takes it off for a truly strong opponent. Its build makes it a popular model for sculptures.
description.guide: The middle stage of Machop's line, a muscular Fighting Pokémon that wears a belt to regulate its enormous strength. Despite its power it is modest and often helps people with manual labour. It evolves into Machamp when traded.
description.tagline: A humble powerhouse whose belt holds its strength in check

description.fun: With four arms, Machamp can throw 500 punches a second, pin all of a foe's limbs at once, and attack and block at the same time; one hand is said to be enough to move a mountain. It knows every martial art in the world. Its arms react faster than it can think, though, so delicate work just gets them tangled.
description.guide: The final stage of Machop's line, a four-armed Fighting Pokémon said to have mastered every martial art. It can throw hundreds of punches a second but is clumsy with delicate tasks. It evolves from Machoke when traded and has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: Four arms, 500 punches a second, zero fine motor skills

description.fun: Gigantamax energy fills its arms and turns its fists orange, so every punch lands like a bomb blast.
